newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish wholesale prices rise 5.5 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Turkish wholesale prices rise 5.5 percent in April.

text.p: Turkey's wholesale prices rose 5.5 percent month-on month in April after a rise of 6.0 percent in March, the State Institute of Statistics said on Sunday.
It said April consumer prices rose by 6.6 percent, compared with a rise of 5.4 percent the previous month.
Year-on year wholesale inflation stood at 72.8 percent, versus 77.0 percent in March, it said.
Year-on-year consumer inflation was 77.2 percent in April, compared with 77.3 in March, the institute said.
